title: Higher-Order Positional Encodings for Graph Representation Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.01903v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Many real-world systems exhibit higher-order interactions among groups of entities that cannot be captured by pairwise relationships alone. Graph Transformers and Graph Neural Networks increasingly rely on positional encodings to enrich graph representations, yet existing positional encodings are computed solely from the original graph and therefore cannot directly capture observed higher-order interactions. Topological Deep Learning addresses this limitation by lifting graphs to simplicial complexes, but typically requires performing message passing or attention on higher-order neural network representations. We introduce a representation learning paradigm that enriches graph representations with higher-order topology through positional encodings, enabling standard graph learning models to exploit lifted incidence structure without modifying the backbone. translated_title: 图表示学习中的高阶位置编码
translated_abstract: 许多现实世界的系统在实体组之间展现出高阶交互作用，这些交互无法仅通过成对关系来捕捉。图Transformer和图神经网络日益依赖位置编码来丰富图表示，然而现有的位置编码仅从原始图计算得出，因此无法直接捕捉观测到的高阶交互。拓扑深度学习通过将图提升为单纯复形来解决这一局限，但通常需要在高阶神经网络表示上执行消息传递或注意力机制。我们引入了一种新的表示学习范式，通过位置编码将高阶拓扑融入图表示，使标准的图学习模型无需修改骨干网络即可利用提升后的关联结构。我们推导出了高阶位置编码表达能力的理论刻画……
tldr: 提出一种通过高阶拓扑位置编码增强图表示的新范式，使标准图学习模型无需修改骨干网络即可捕捉和利用数据中的高阶交互信息。
en_tdlr: Proposes a new representation learning paradigm that enriches graph representations with higher-order topology through positional encodings, enabling standard graph learning models to exploit higher-order interactions without modifying the backbone.
